text: I am not in the WAIT camp. On day_vol 1.58 the H1 closed at 14.0% of the day's range with LH/LL and D red: heavy volume closing near the low is C25's distribution warning, and ABOVE_STRUCTURE with coil warn gives no base (R3). reclaim:ma_20 buys into that; I do not ratify it. I hold OPPOSE. What clears it: h1_close_above:bar_high on volume at least 1.4x normal with the close in the upper half of the day's range (C16, C25).
